transcript.text: Guys now to the barbarians. The
barbarians are also getting toned down
in a similar way. The barbarians hit
points are getting buffed by 4% but in
return the evolved Barbarians hit point
bonus is going from 10% to 0%. So now
the regular Barbs and the Evo Barbs will
have the same HP. I am definitely a fan
of that. I don't really know why they
had different HPs anyway. I thought it
was like a little bit silly to be
honest. And guys, now the evolved Barbs
rage duration is also getting a buff.
Your your Barbs will now be raged for
three sec for five seconds instead of
three seconds, which I think is a pretty
fair buff. I did feel like that the rage
from the Barbs went away a little bit
quickly anyway. So now you know, that
will be a little bit better. I think
that's pretty fair for the Barbs.
Although I don't even know if that like
worse I don't know. I'm kind of
confused. Seems like just a pretty big
buff. I know the goal was to buff them
overall cuz Barbs are not like a very
used card but still seems pretty big.
I'm all right with it though. And the
Goblins and the Hero Goblins are having
the exact same thing happen to it. They
are nerfing the Hero Goblins, making it
so every time you pop the ability
instead of getting three Goblins, you
will now get two. But it will only take
one second for the Goblins to deploy
now. So the Goblins even though there's
less of them, they will be come like
they will be coming out quicker. So you
have to respond to them faster. And the
Goblin damage overall all across the
board is getting a 4% buff. So that
applies you know to Goblin Barrel,
Goblin Drill, and all those types of
cards that just have any type of Goblins
like Goblin Gang. And then even the Evo
Mortar Goblin as well will you know do a
little bit more damage cuz the Evo
Mortar does spawn that a little Goblin.
And now guys, finally to the nerfs. So
many balance changes this season but I
can't say that I'm not a fan of it cuz I
definitely do enjoy that there is so
many balance changes this time around. I
do feel like that we were long overdue
for a massive set of balance changes.
First off with the nerfs guys, there is
a nerf to the evolved archers. Evolved
archers have been super popular so I
think this is a pretty solid nerf right
here. I I don't know if they like needed
a big nerf or a small nerf but they are
getting a pretty decent nerf. Their
power shot damage is going down by 17%
which is I say pretty sizable. Will
change quite a few interactions. The
snowball Evo is also getting a nerf. I
think that was to compensate for the
buff that they're giving to the Goblin
Drill with the Goblin damage. The roll
range is now 4.5 to 4. So, the Evo
snowball just won't be you know grabbing
as many units and throwing them as far
back as it was before which I definitely
think is a very good change cuz the Evo
snowball was kind of just like a
ridiculous card anyway in my opinion. Oh
my god, that executioner's going stupid.
Okay, let's just go for the minor here.
Hold on guys. I'm actually having
trouble yapping about the balance
changes while defending here.
And the evolved Goblin Barrel guys is
also getting a nerf. Although this does
make me sad, I would be straight lying
if I said it wasn't extremely extremely
deserved man. Okay, maybe I'll have to
boss ban it to this list. Jesus Christ.
Um the evolved Goblin Barrel is getting

especially considering that basically

they're just kind of like returning the
